items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember we were there with the trio and worked opposite Buddy Rich.

ctx.x: The Metropole is still open under different management, shall we say, now. [laughs]

Absolutely. There used to be a little room upstairs that I played. They had this little jazz club on the floor above. A lot of good groups worked there. I remember we were there with the trio and worked opposite Buddy Rich. Meanwhile, they’d have something like Woody Herman or somebody, downstairs.
Lionel Hampton’s band played there a lot.
